title: Audio upload files
responsibility: Provides the file inputs for a single recording or a before/after pair.

inputs.name: AudioUploadFiles.mode
inputs.description: Required mode string. Exactly comparison renders before and after fields; every other value renders one audio field.

inputs.name: AudioUploadFiles.uploading
inputs.description: Required flag disabling file inputs during an upload.

outputs.name: AudioUploadFiles
outputs.description: Required file pickers accepting WAV, MP3, M4A and OGG extensions/MIME hints, with selected filenames or hints. Performs no upload or byte validation. Parent is expected to remount on reset or mode change to clear file/name state.
